title: UPLAND R70 current complete bike
notes: The exact current manufacturer page claims approximately 8.3 kg bare without pedals or computer mount for the displayed Shimano 105 Di2 R7170/R7150 2x12 build. It documents T700+T800 carbon, BB86 and fitted Michelin Dynamic Sport 700x25C tires. Other current exact R70 routes offer Shimano 105 R7120 mechanical 2x12, so the retained cards do not select one drivetrain; no manufacturer maximum tire clearance is published.
